sloka: स तेभ्यः तु नमः कृत्वा सुग्रीवाय च मारुतिः ।दिशः सर्वाः समालोक्य अशोक वनिकाम् प्रति ॥५-१३-६०॥
transliteration: sa tebhyaḥ tu namaḥ kṛtvā sugrīvāya ca mārutiḥ ।diśaḥ sarvāḥ samālokya aśoka vanikām prati ॥5-13-60॥

translations.english: Having offered salutations to all gods as well as to Sugriva, he looked at all quarters and left for the Ashoka grove.
